questions.solution: 12. (a) The slant height of the original cone is \[\sqrt{36^2+48^2}=60\text{ cm}.\] The curved surface area of the original cone is \(\pi(36)(60)=2160\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) The height of the removed small cone is \(48-30=18\text{ cm}.\) Since the depth of water is 24 cm, the height of the cone up to the water surface is \(18+24=42\text{ cm}.\) By similarity, the required wet curved surface area is \(2160\pi\left[\left(\frac{42}{48}\right)^2-\left(\frac{18}{48}\right)^2\right].\) \[=2160\pi\left[\left(\frac78\right)^2-\left(\frac38\right)^2\right] =2160\pi\left(\frac{40}{64}\right) =1350\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] ------------------(4) (b) The volume of the original cone is \[\frac13\pi(36)^2(48)=20736\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] The empty space above the current water surface corresponds to the part of the original cone above height 42 cm from the vertex. Its volume is \(20736\pi-20736\pi\left(\frac{42}{48}\right)^3.\) \[=20736\pi\left[1-\left(\frac78\right)^3\right] \approx 21502.6\text{ cm}^3 =0.0215\text{ m}^3.\] Since \(0.2>0.0215,\) the vessel will overflow. Therefore, Nathan's claim is correct. ------------------(3)

(a) Find the volume of \(X\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) \(Y\) is a vessel in the shape of a frustum which is made by cutting off the lower part of an inverted right circular cone. (a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(X\) 的體積。

(b) \(Y\) 為一個截頭錐形容器，由切除一個倒置直立圓錐的下部造成。\(Y\) 的上底半徑為 \(24\) cm，下底半徑為 \(16\) cm。\(Y\) 與 \(X\) 形狀相似。\(Y\) 盛有 \(3500\pi\text{ cm}^3\) 水。將 \(X\) 放入 \(Y\) 中，\(X\) 完全浸入水中且沒有溢出。某人聲稱 \(Y\) 中水深超過 \(15\) cm。該聲稱是否正確？試解釋你的答案。
（8 分）

questions.solution: 14. (a) The slant height of the original cone is \[\sqrt{15^2+36^2}=39.\] Its curved surface area is \[\pi(15)(39)=585\pi.\] Hence the curved surface area of the cone cut off is \[585\pi-325\pi=260\pi.\] Let the radius of the cone cut off be \(r\). Since curved surface areas of similar cones are in the square of the linear ratio, \[\left(\frac{r}{15}\right)^2=\frac{260}{585}=\frac49.\] Thus \[ r=10. \] The height of the cone cut off is \[\frac{10}{15}\times 36=24.\] Therefore, the volume of \(X\) is \[\frac13\pi(15)^2(36)-\frac13\pi(10)^2(24) =2700\pi-800\pi =1900\pi.\] (b) Since \(Y\) is similar to \(X\), the linear scale factor from \(X\) to \(Y\) is \[\frac{24}{15}=1.6.\] The smaller cone cut off from the larger inverted cone for \(Y\) has radius \(16\text{ cm}\), corresponding to radius \(10\text{ cm}\) in \(X\). Its height is \[24(1.6)=38.4\text{ cm}.\] The volume of this smaller cone is \[\frac13\pi(16)^2(38.4)=3276.8\pi.\] After \(X\) is immersed, the total volume below the water surface, measured from the apex of the smaller cone, is \[3276.8\pi+3500\pi+1900\pi=8676.8\pi.\] Let the water depth in \(Y\) be \(x\text{ cm}\). (a) Find the final volume of water in the vessel in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) Someone claims that the area of the wet curved surface of the vessel is at most \(1100\text{ cm}^2\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(6 marks)
questions.stemZh:
11. 一個倒置直立圓錐形容器盛有一些水，容器垂直放置。水深為 \(12\) cm。再倒入 \(950\pi\text{ cm}^3\) 水後，水深變為 \(18\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求容器中最終的水體積。

(b) 某人聲稱容器的濕曲面面積最多為 \(1100\text{ cm}^2\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
（6 分）

questions.solution: 11. (a) Let the final volume of water be \(x\text{ cm}^3\). Since the depths before and after pouring are \(12\text{ cm}\) and \(18\text{ cm}\), the volume ratio is \[12^3:18^3=8:27.\] Thus \[\frac{x-950\pi}{x}=\frac{8}{27}.\] Hence \[27(x-950\pi)=8x.\] So \[19x=25650\pi,\] and \[x=1350\pi.\] Therefore, the final volume is \[1350\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) Let \(r\text{ cm}\) be the radius of the water surface after pouring. Then \[\frac13\pi r^2(18)=1350\pi.\] Hence \[ r=15. \] The slant height of the wet cone is \[\sqrt{15^2+18^2}=\sqrt{549}.\] The wet curved surface area is \[\pi(15)\sqrt{549}\approx 1104.148\text{ cm}^2.\] Since this is greater than \(1100\text{ cm}^2\), I disagree with the claim.

If the water can just fill up \(X\), find the height of \(X\). 12. (a) 將錐體倒置，被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐及一個小錐體。已知截頭錐高 \(9\) cm，求截頭錐的體積。

(a) 所述的截頭錐，下部為高 \(8\) cm 的長方體。將水倒入容器至深度 \(11\) cm，求容器中水的體積。

questions.solution: 14. (a) The volume of the original pyramid is \[\frac13(20)^2(18)=2400\text{ cm}^3.\] The height of the smaller pyramid is \[18-9=9\text{ cm}.\] The ratio of the heights of the smaller pyramid and the original pyramid is \[9:18=1:2.\] Therefore, the ratio of their volumes is \[1^3:2^3=1:8.\] The volume of the smaller pyramid is \[\frac{1}{8}(2400)=300\text{ cm}^3.\] Hence the volume of the frustum is \[2400-300=2100\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) The lower cuboid has square base of side \(10\) cm, so the volume of water in the cuboid is \[10^2(8)=800\text{ cm}^3.\] Since the water depth is \(11\) cm, the height of water in the frustum is \[11-8=3\text{ cm}.\] The corresponding similar pyramids have heights \(12\) cm and \(9\) cm, so their height ratio is \[12:9=4:3.\] The volume of the pyramid of height \(9\) cm is \(300\text{ cm}^3\). Thus the volume of the pyramid of height \(12\) cm is \[300\left(\frac{4}{3}\right)^3=\frac{6400}{9}\text{ cm}^3.\] Therefore, the volume of water in the frustum part is \[\frac{6400}{9}-300=\frac{3700}{9}\text{ cm}^3.\] The total volume of water is \[800+\frac{3700}{9} =\frac{10900}{9} \approx 1210\text{ cm}^3\] correct to 3 significant figures.

questions.stemZh:
14. 一個直立圓錐被兩個平行於底面的平面分成三部分。圓錐上部的底半徑及高分別為 \(6\) cm 及 \(20\) cm。

(b) 若中間部分的高為 \(10\) cm，求中間部分的體積。（3 分）

questions.solution: 14. (a) The volume of the upper cone is \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(6)^2(20)=240\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (2 marks) (b) Since the planes are parallel to the base, the cones are similar. The upper cone has height 20 cm and radius 6 cm. For the cone formed by the upper and middle parts, its height is \[20+10=30\text{ cm}.\] By similarity, its radius is \[6\cdot\frac{30}{20}=9\text{ cm}.\] Hence the volume of the cone formed by the upper and middle parts is \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(9)^2(30)=810\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] Therefore, the volume of the middle part is \[810\pi-240\pi=570\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (3 marks) (c) The whole cone has height \[20+10+10=40\text{ cm}.\] By similarity, its base radius is \[6\cdot\frac{40}{20}=12\text{ cm}.\] The radius at the top of the lower part is \(9\) cm, and the radius at the bottom of the lower part is \(12\) cm. The height of the lower part is \(10\) cm, so its slant height is \[\sqrt{10^2+(12-9)^2}=\sqrt{109}\text{ cm}.\] The curved surface area of the lower frustum is \[\pi(9+12)\sqrt{109}=21\sqrt{109}\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] Since \[21\sqrt{109}>200,\] the curved surface area is more than \(200\pi\text{ cm}^2\). Therefore, I agree with Amy's claim. (4 marks)

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(Z\) 的體積。（3 分）

(b) 另一個實心直立圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐 \(S\) 及一個圓錐 \(T\)。\(S\) 的高為 \(16\) cm，\(S\) 的總表面積等於 \(Y\) 與 \(Z\) 的總表面積之和。\(Z\) 與 \(S\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。（4 分）

questions.solution: 14. (a) For the bottom frustum \(Z\), the lower radius is 20 cm and the height is 12 cm. Its upper plane is at a distance \[48-12=36\text{ cm}\] from the vertex of the original cone. By similarity of cones, the upper radius of \(Z\) is \[20\left(\frac{36}{48}\right)=15\text{ cm}.\] The volume of \(Z\) is \[\frac13\pi(12)(20^2+20\cdot 15+15^2)\] \[=4\pi(400+300+225) =3700\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (3 marks) (b) The slant height of \(Z\) is \[\sqrt{12^2+(20-15)^2}=13.\] The total surface area of \(Z\) is \[\pi(20+15)(13)+\pi(20)^2+\pi(15)^2\] \[=455\pi+400\pi+225\pi =1080\pi.\] Since \(Y\) and \(Z\) are similar, and the lower radius of \(Y\) is the upper radius of \(Z\), the linear scale factor from \(Z\) to \(Y\) is \[\frac{15}{20}=\frac34.\] Therefore, the total surface area of \(Y\) is \[1080\pi\left(\frac34\right)^2=607.5\pi.\] Hence the total surface area of \(S\) is \[1080\pi+607.5\pi=1687.5\pi.\] Now \[\frac{\text{TSA of }S}{\text{TSA of }Z} =\frac{1687.5\pi}{1080\pi} =\frac{25}{16},\] but \[\left(\frac{\text{height of }S}{\text{height of }Z}\right)^2 =\left(\frac{16}{12}\right)^2 =\frac{16}{9}.\] Since \[\frac{25}{16}\ne\frac{16}{9},\] \(Z\) and \(S\) are not similar. 12. A solid metal right prism of base area \(84\text{ cm}^2\) and height \(20\) cm is melted and recast into two similar solid right pyramids. The bases of the two pyramids are squares. The ratio of the base area of the smaller pyramid to the base area of the larger pyramid is \(4:9\).

(a) Find the volume of the larger pyramid.

(b) If the height of the larger pyramid is \(12\) cm, find the total surface area of the smaller pyramid.
(7 marks)
questions.stemZh:
12. 一個底面積 \(84\text{ cm}^2\)、高 \(20\) cm 的實心直立棱柱熔化後，重鑄成兩個相似的實心直立錐體，兩錐底面均為正方形。較小錐與較大錐的底面積比為 \(4:9\)。

(a) 求較大錐的體積。

(b) 若較大錐的高為 \(12\) cm，求較小錐的總表面積。
（7 分）
questions.hint: Similar solids: area ratio = k², volume ratio = k³.
questions.hintZh:
柱體：體積 = 底面積 × 高。
錐體：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\) × 底面積 × 高。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: The total volume of metal is \(84(20)=1680\text{ cm}^3.\) The ratio of corresponding lengths of the smaller pyramid to the larger pyramid is \(\sqrt{4:9}=2:3.\) Hence the ratio of their volumes is \(8:27.\) (a) The volume of the larger pyramid is \[1680\left(\frac{27}{8+27}\right)=1296\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) The volume of the smaller pyramid is \[1680-1296=384\text{ cm}^3.\] The height of the smaller pyramid is \[\frac23(12)=8\text{ cm}.\] Let the side length of its square base be \(s\). Then \[\frac13s^2(8)=384\] so \[s^2=144,\qquad s=12.\] The slant height of each triangular face is \[\sqrt{8^2+6^2}=10.\] Thus the total surface area is \[144+4\left(\frac12(12)(10)\right)=384\text{ cm}^2.\] Final answers: (a) \(1296\text{ cm}^3\); (b) \(384\text{ cm}^2\).

questions.stemZh:
13. 有兩個實心金屬球。較小球與較大球的表面積比為 \(4:9\)，較大球半徑為 \(9\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求較小球的體積。

(b) 兩球熔化後重鑄成兩個實心直立圓錐，記為 \(A\) 及 \(B\)。已知 \(A\) 的高及底半徑分別為 \(10\) cm 及 \(6\) cm，某學生量得 \(B\) 的底半徑為 \(12\) cm。該學生聲稱 \(A\) 與 \(B\) 相似。該聲稱是否正確？試解釋你的答案。
（7 分）

圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。

Therefore \[V_{\text{smaller}}=\frac{8}{27}\cdot \frac{4}{3}\pi(9)^3=288\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) The volume of \(A\) is \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(6)^2(10)=120\pi.\] The volume of \(B\) is \[288\pi+\frac{4}{3}\pi(9)^3-120\pi=1140\pi.\] Thus \[\frac{V_B}{V_A}=\frac{1140\pi}{120\pi}=\frac{19}{2}.\] If \(A\) and \(B\) were similar, the volume ratio should be \[\left(\frac{12}{6}\right)^3=8.\] Since \(8\ne \frac{19}{2}\), \(A\) and \(B\) are not similar. 14. The base radius and the curved surface area of a solid metal right circular cone are \(14\text{ cm}\) and \(700\pi\text{ cm}^2\) respectively.

(a) Find the height of the circular cone.

(b) The circular cone is divided into a right circular cone \(X\) and a frustum \(Y\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The curved surface area of \(Y\) is 15 times the curved surface area of \(X\).

(i) Express the volume of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\).
(ii) If \(Y\) is melted and recast into 2 identical solid spheres, find the diameter of each sphere.
(8 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個實心金屬直立圓錐的底半徑及曲面面積分別為 \(14\) cm 及 \(700\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。

(a) 求圓錐的高。

(b) 該圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(X\) 及一個截頭錐 \(Y\)。\(Y\) 的曲面面積為 \(X\) 的 \(15\) 倍。

(i) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(Y\) 的體積。
(ii) 若將 \(Y\) 熔化重鑄成兩個相同的實心球，求每個球的直徑。
（8 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
questions.solution: (a) Let \(l\) be the slant height of the circular cone. Since the curved surface area is \(700\pi\), \[\pi(14)l=700\pi.\] Thus \[ l=50. \] The height is \[\sqrt{50^2-14^2}=48\text{ cm}.\] (b)(i) Since the curved surface area of \(Y\) is 15 times that of \(X\), the whole cone has curved surface area \(16\) times that of \(X\). Therefore the linear scale factor from \(X\) to the whole cone is \(1:4\), and the volume of \(X\) is \(\frac{1}{64}\) of the volume of the whole cone. The volume of the whole cone is \(\frac{1}{3}\pi(14)^2(48)=3136\pi.\) Hence \(V_Y=3136\pi\left(1-\frac{1}{64}\right)=3087\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) (b)(ii) If the diameter of each sphere is \(d\), then \(2\cdot \frac{4}{3}\pi\left(\frac{d}{2}\right)^3=3087\pi.\) Solving gives \(d=21.\) Final answers: (a) \(48\text{ cm}\); (b)(i) \(3087\pi\text{ cm}^3\); (b)(ii) \(21\text{ cm}\).

(a) Express the volume of \(X\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) Express the total surface area of \(X\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(c) \(X\) is melted and recast into a solid cube. Does the total surface area of the cube exceed the total surface area of \(X\)? Explain your answer.

questions.stemZh:
14. 一個實心金屬直立圓錐的高及底半徑分別為 \(45\) cm 及 \(24\) cm。該圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐及一個截頭錐 \(X\)。已知 \(X\) 的高為 \(30\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(X\) 的體積。

(b) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(X\) 的總表面積。

(c) 將 \(X\) 熔化重鑄成一個實心立方體。立方體的總表面積是否超過 \(X\) 的總表面積？試解釋你的答案。

questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。

questions.solution: (a) The height of the small cone is \[45-30=15\text{ cm}.\] The small cone is similar to the original cone with linear scale factor \[\frac{15}{45}=\frac13.\] Therefore the volume of \(X\) is \[\frac13\pi(24)^2(45)\left(1-\left(\frac13\right)^3\right) =8320\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) The slant height of the original cone is \[\sqrt{24^2+45^2}=51\text{ cm}.\] The radius and slant height of the small cone are respectively \[8\text{ cm} \text{and} 17\text{ cm}.\] The curved surface area of \(X\) is \[\pi(24)(51)-\pi(8)(17).\] The two circular faces have total area \[\pi(24)^2+\pi(8)^2.\] Hence the total surface area of \(X\) is \[\pi(24)(51)-\pi(8)(17)+\pi(24)^2+\pi(8)^2 =1728\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] (c) Let the side length of the cube be \(x\) cm. Since the volume is unchanged, \[x^3=8320\pi.\] Thus \[x\approx 29.6773.\] The total surface area of the cube is \[6x^2\approx 5284.45\text{ cm}^2.\] Also, \[1728\pi\approx 5428.67\text{ cm}^2.\] Since \[5284.45<5428.67,\] the total surface area of the cube does not exceed the total surface area of \(X\). Final answers: (a) \(8320\pi\text{ cm}^3\); (b) \(1728\pi\text{ cm}^2\); (c) no.
questions.solutionZh:
（a）小錐高 15，線性比 1/3：
\[
V_X=\frac13\pi(24)^2(45)\left(1-\frac1{27}\right)=8320\pi\text{ cm}^3.
\]

(a) Express the volume of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) A craftsman finds that the height of \(Y\) is 9 cm.

questions.solution: The volume of the cylinder is \(96\pi(38)=3648\pi.\) The base areas of the smaller and larger cones are in the ratio \(9:25\), so their linear ratio is \(3:5\) and their volume ratio is \(27:125\). (a) \[V_{\text{smaller}}=3648\pi\cdot\frac{27}{27+125} =\boxed{648\pi\text{ cm}^3}.\] (b) Let the height of the smaller cone be \(h\). Since its base radius is \(6\) cm, \[\frac13\pi(6)^2h=648\pi,\] so \[ h=54. \] The slant height of the smaller cone is \[\sqrt{6^2+54^2}=6\sqrt{82}.\] The curved surface area of the smaller cone is \[\pi(6)(6\sqrt{82})=36\pi\sqrt{82}.\] The ratio of the curved surface areas is \(9:25\). Hence the curved surface area of the larger cone is \[36\pi\sqrt{82}\cdot\frac{25}{9}=100\pi\sqrt{82}\approx \boxed{2845\text{ cm}^2}.\]
